children: TRABZONSPOR SPORTİF YATIRIM VE FUTBOL İŞLETMECİLİĞİ TİCARET
SAID ON WEDNESDAY, IT SIGNS FRANCULINO GLUDO DJU FROM MIDTJYLLAND
TO PAY 17 MLN EUROS TO MIDTJYLLAND IN 8 INSTALLMENTS OVER 5 YEARS AS CONTRACT TERMINATION FEE, TO PAY CONDITIONAL BONUSES
TO PAY 15% OF PROCEEDS AFTER PAYMENT TO MIDTJYLLAND DEDUCTED FROM FUTURE TRANSFERS TO MIDTJYLLAND
TO PAY FOOTBALL PLAYER 2.1 MLN EUR PER SEASON AND 2.4 MLN EUR FOR OPTIONAL SEASON
TO PAY 4.7% OF GROSS SALARY AS MANAGER'S FEE
